🌍 Flag facts
🦅
The eagle comes from the coat of arms of the United States.
🏹
The eagle holds three arrows for the three main islands: St Croix, St Thomas and St John.
🗓️
The flag was adopted in 1921, a few years after the USA bought the islands from Denmark.
🚗
The US Virgin Islands are the only place in the USA where people drive on the left.
